stories.headline: Why is Lululemon Stock Crashing, and is it a Generational Buying Opportunity?
stories.body: Lululemon (NASDAQ: LULU) reported quarterly financial results that disappointed investors.

stories.headline: Maine bank hopes branch makeovers will attract deposits
stories.body: Mirroring the efforts of a number of larger institutions, Portland-based Northeast Bank plans to open a de novo branch in Bangor and renovate its seven existing branches.

stories.headline: FinTechs Follow Corporate Clients Into Bigger Financial Relationships
stories.body: FinTechs are finding more growth in large corporate relationships, whether by winning larger customers or handling more of the financial activity of companies they already serve.
